content.comment_body: Hello, I manage two identical [product_name] devices with the same program via their respective [product_name] web pages. This setup has worked well in the past. Currently, one [product_name] is functioning as expected, but the other no longer displays data on its web page, even though the device is running and the network appears fine. I am able to monitor data using [product_name] software, and I have uploaded both the device and the web project files. Direct connection to the PC produces the same result: the web page loads, but no data shows. Does anyone know what else I could check?
Please share your web editor project and the [product_name] program files.

I've already given this a try, but I'll do it again. After a while, a switch icon appears active at the top of the web page. Is this related to data transfer speed? The page itself loads normally. Could Microsoft Edge be blocking something? For the working [product_name], the indicator is displayed: [IMAGE]. For the non-working [product_name], this shows red and the address begins with https://192.....

Please provide more details. What are the IP addresses and subnet masks of your [product_name] devices? What does your PC use for IP address and subnet mask? Are you connecting the PC to the devices directly, or through a router?
I hope this provides more clarity. [IMAGE]
If you've used those settings, it looks like both [product_name] devices have the same IP address. This setup cannot function properly... [IMAGE]
Apologies, I copied and forgot to update the details. [product_name] A is 192.168.1.15, [product_name] B is 192.168.1.16.
Try restarting [product_name] A and then refresh the web page. Does it work?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing a situation where one of two identical [product_name] devices fails to show data on its web editor interface, even though the device is running and accessible via other tools. The network is functional, and trying both direct and network connections yields the same issue: the web page loads with no data. The other identical device does not experience this issue, leaving the user without a clear solution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects both web interfaces on their [product_name] devices to function reliably, consistently presenting real-time data as expected.
